---
name: comm-create-git-branch
description: Use when creating a new independent task or feature branch, especially from another unfinished branch or when its base or name is uncertain.
---

# Create a task branch

Inputs: agreed task/outcome, repository and authorized local operation.

1. Before mutation read
   harness/common/skills/comm-commit-task-stages/references/work-safety.md.
   Read harness/common/skills/comm-verify-project-facts/references/git-base-state.md
   for remote/integration identity, freshness and checked SHAs.
2. Independent work starts from that fresh remote integration SHA. Never
   implicitly inherit unfinished HEAD. Do not update/check out local integration
   merely to branch. Deferred/dependent work requires the update procedure first.
3. Before naming/creation read [naming](references/naming.md).
   Unknown task/outcome, prefix, remote or collision needs the user's answer.
4. Use an explicit start SHA; create only a new local branch, without replacing
   an existing ref. If state changes or the host prevents creation, stop and report.
   Choose checkout/worktree placement within authority and work-safety limits.
5. Verify exact name, HEAD equals selected SHA, and preserved edits/staging.
   Report task, branch, source SHA and freshness limits; never claim uncreated work.

Done: the intended local branch exists on the verified base.
Commit, push, PR, harness execution and publication retain their own gates.
comm-create-git-branch.references/naming.md:
# Branch naming

Format: <git-user>/<short-meaningful-name>. Use the current Git user's effective
repository email local part before @, without printing the address. Do not
substitute user.name or a hosting login. Missing/ambiguous email or invalid
derived prefix: ask for a short prefix and wait; never silently normalize it.

Choose a brief action, feature or outcome; never automatically copy a ticket
title. Common requires no Linear, ticket or ticket identifier.
Example: octadim/add-agent-use-some-tool.
Validate the literal full name with git check-ref-format --branch; do not accept
previous-checkout shorthand as the proposed literal name.
Check local and fresh intended-remote branch names. On collision warn, propose
another meaningful name and await explicit choice. Never overwrite, force-create
or invent a suffix. Recheck the chosen alternative and stop on creation races.
